api.builder protocol: builder(ctx, members, variant) -> plan dict {id, family, members, duration_s, policy_profile, profile, perturbation_profile} (probe.ease_plan shape) or None
api.charge(root, ident, sim_s, *, stage, bra: atomic fcntl-locked precharge (fcntl_compat on Windows); refuses unregistered root, duplicate ids, over-cap
api.collect(root, world, arm, weights, *, se: ONE base-policy episode charged 1200 before physics; per window the earliest pair+wall > pair > wall moment; ctx dirs collect/c4v_<arm>_<cell>_s<seed>/ctx_t<t0>/{CONTEXT.json, SNAPSHOT.pt} with policy_profile + cav_track (180 s) of every zone CAV, rows_t0, geometry, N3 lead
api.extract(root, *, range_m=200, cell=None): CLEAN4_MOVES_B.jsonl, CLEAN4_MOVES_R.jsonl, CLEAN4_NEGATIVES.jsonl, POTENTIAL_INPUTS.json (per cell screened_moments, robust_moments, b_examples[{id, reachable, robust}], sources with sha256 for clean4_potential.verdict)
api.init(root, cap=80000, *, base): sealed REGISTRATION.json (phase, cap, rules, module sha); idempotent
api.n3_select(rows, t, *, geom) / selector(g: default observable selector (NEWMAP2 rule verbatim); rows are observable projections (vid, s_m, v_mps, lane, is_cav, length_m) only
api.plans(ctx, variants=None, *, builder) /: B: pair_g/pair_h/pair_t/wall_g/wall_h (families closing_pair/abreast_wall); R: 2 seeded random proposals (family R_random); returns groups + member solos (replay_bank.solo_candidate) + meta
api.run_context(root, ctx_dir, *, builder, s: plans -> results/plans.jsonl -> verify; names restricts the registered slate
api.verify(root, ctx_dir, groups, *, seeds=3: seed-1 screen = ONE sv.verify(policy + groups + solos); pass iff adv LB95>0 and >=1 veh-s, synergy LB95>0 and >=1 veh-s, collision/teleport deltas<=0; then the probe_native path into <root>/minebank/bank (first-seed sv.verify + confirm_all8 extra_seeds=seeds-2); whole-stage quotes checked before dispatch; seed-2/extra salts guarded

budget_notes.note: 80,000 covers roughly 2-3 confirmed moments (collect 1,200 per world x arm); one robust group = 3 B examples (seeds 1-3), so the >=8-example gate needs >=3 robust groups. The confirmation quote is an upper bound (admission on every seed). Windows follow the coopmwm convention (t0+D+120; extended later harm t0+D+600, capped at 1200), not the N3 fixed 300 s; never shortened below sv.TAIL_S.

caveats: potential denominator: screened_moments counts every re-screened B moment; if only N3-lead worlds are collected the share is conditional on N3 admission (screened_with_lead is reported).
replay_bank._confirm_charge is rebound process-wide during one confirmation (scoped, always restored); run one context per process (the CLI does).
R rows carry family R_random (clean3 projects acceleration plans onto the move vocabulary).
